question: ​In December 2021, what is the amount of overdraft for which the provision was made under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY - NRLM) for verified SHG members having accounts under the Prime Minister Jan Dhan Yojana with Banks?
solution:
The correct answer is** Rs. 5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Deendayal Anty****odaya Yojana**

 
 
• ​Aajivika – NRLM was renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihood Mission (DAY-NRLM) in **November 2015.**
 
• Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) of the **Ministry of Rural Developmen**t launched **152 Centers for Financial Literacy** & Service Delivery (SAKSHAM Centers) in **77 districts of 13 states** between** October 4 and 8, 2021**, as part of **Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav.**
 
• The central government's DAY-NRLM is essentially a program to **alleviate poverty.**
 
• It aims to develop institutional platforms that are both **effective and efficient **in order to give the poor in rural areas better access to **financial services **and more sustainable means of subsistence, thereby increasing household income.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prime Minister Jan Dhan Yojana**

 
 
• The Indian **Prime Minister Narendra Modi **launched this campaign for financial inclusion on **August 28, 2014.**
 
• On** August 15, 2014**, in his first** Independence Day **speech, he revealed this scheme.
 
• **​**Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, also known as the **Prime Minister's Public Finance Scheme**, is a financial inclusion program run by the Indian government that is open to all citizens.
 
• Its goal is to **increase affordable access to financial services** like **bank accounts, remittances, credit, insurance, and pensions**.
 
• Minors under the **age of 10** can also** open accounts **with a guardian to manage them.
